summary: Reviewed all four supplied PNGs at native 1x and nearest 3x. idle_a has a readable right-facing three-quarter human silhouette: long pale robe, teal sash, tied-back dark hair, and a clean-shaven face. The face and visible limbs are coherent at native size. Broad light cloth clusters and darker folds give the robe volume; hair highlights generally support upper-left lighting. Both boots end at y=60 and the stance reads grounded. The raised hand encloses the sword grip around (42,34); the lowered hand meets the scabbard around (24,41). No obvious accidental outline break or interior transparency defect is visible across the three backgrounds; the small transparent gap at (18,49)-(18,50) reads as separation between scabbard and robe. The thin pale blade is least distinct against the light background, but remains readable in this preview. This keep recommendation is limited to idle_a. The other eight poses, frame continuity, dash and slash motion, skill effects, and actual battle readability cannot be assessed from these static previews. PNG inspection does not establish literal pxgrid authorship, and geometry compliance alone is not visual approval. Final selection remains with the user.
